title: San Diego Housing Price Predictor
description: Built a regression model using scikit-learn to predict housing prices across San Diego neighborhoods. Achieved 87% accuracy using proximity to UCSD, school ratings, and historical price trends.

title: COVID-19 Vaccination Dashboard
description: Created an interactive D3.js dashboard visualizing vaccination rates across US counties. Integrated CDC data with choropleth maps and time-series charts for trend analysis.

title: Twitter Sentiment Analysis
description: Trained a BERT-based NLP model to classify tweet sentiment in real time. Achieved 91% accuracy on a 50,000-tweet test set using fine-tuning on Hugging Face Transformers.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Designed and built this responsive portfolio from scratch using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Features dark mode, dynamic project rendering, and GitHub API integration.

title: Spotify Listening Trends Visualizer
description: Connected to the Spotify API to pull personal listening data and visualize genre distribution, top artists, and listening habits over time using Observable Plot.

title: UCSD Course Enrollment Predictor
description: Analyzed historical WebReg data to predict course availability during enrollment. Used logistic regression and random forests to flag courses likely to fill within the first hour.

title: Wildfire Spread Simulation
description: Simulated wildfire propagation across California terrain using a cellular automaton model. Incorporated wind speed, humidity, and vegetation density as input variables.

title: Image Classifier: Birds vs. Planes
description: Built a convolutional neural network using PyTorch to distinguish birds from aircraft in aerial photography. Trained on 10,000 labeled images with 94% test accuracy.

title: NBA Player Performance Dashboard
description: Scraped 10 seasons of NBA stats from Basketball Reference and built a dashboard comparing player efficiency ratings, shooting zones, and playoff vs. regular season splits.

title: Triton Food Pantry Inventory System
description: Developed a web app for UCSD's food pantry to track inventory, log donations, and alert volunteers when items run low. Built with Flask, SQLite, and vanilla JS.

title: Climate Data Explorer
description: Processed 50 years of NOAA climate records and created interactive visualizations showing temperature anomalies, precipitation trends, and extreme weather frequency.

title: Fake News Detector
description: Fine-tuned a RoBERTa model on the LIAR dataset to detect misinformation in news headlines. Deployed as a browser extension that flags potentially misleading articles in real time.
